summary:
[  edit  ]
The Align  SOP  aligns a group of primitives to each other or to an auxiliary input, by translating or rotating each primitive along any pivot point.
Left and Right Primitives  - The notions of "left" and "right" which follow depend on context. If an auxiliary input is used, it is always the right primitive and the primary input geometry are all left primitives. If only one input is used, then for each pair being aligned, there is a left and a right primitive. This means that relative to neighbouring primitives, one primitive can be both left and right.

parameters.label: Bias
parameters.name: bias
parameters.description: Determines which primitive remains unaffected: 0 Left, 1 Right.

parameters.label: Left UV
parameters.name: leftuv
parameters.description: ⊞  - Pivot Location for each "left" primitive.

parameters.label: Right UV
parameters.name: rightuv
parameters.description: ⊞  - Pivot location for each "right" primitive.

parameters.label: Right UV End
parameters.name: rightuvend
parameters.description: ⊞  - If an auxiliary input is used, this location specifies an end point for the alignment. Left primitives are then distributed uniformly between the  Right UV  and the  Right UV End .

parameters.label: Individual Alignment
parameters.name: individual
parameters.description: Causes each primitive of the input to be aligned. If unchecked, only the first primitive is aligned and all others are placed relative to it, preserving the spatial layout of the left primitives.

parameters.label: Translate
parameters.name: dotrans
parameters.description: When enabled, translates primitives during alignment by translating the left UV position to the right UV position.

parameters.label: Rotate
parameters.name: dorotate
parameters.description: When enabled, rotates primitives during alignment by aligning the left UV tangents (at the left UV position) to the right UV tangents (at the right UV position).

parameters.label: Transform Order
parameters.name: xord
parameters.description: ⊞  - Sets the overall transform and rotation order for the transformations. The transform and rotation order determines the order in which transformations take place. Depending on the order, you can achieve different results using the exact same values.

parameters.label: Rotate Order
parameters.name: rord
parameters.description: ⊞  - Sets the overall transform and rotation order for the transformations. The transform and rotation order determines the order in which transformations take place. Depending on the order, you can achieve different results using the exact same values.

parameters.label: Translate
parameters.name: t
parameters.description: ⊞  - Allows you to perform a post-alignment transformation. Specify the amount of translation about the local  xyz  axes.

parameters.label: Rotate
parameters.name: r
parameters.description: ⊞  - Allows you to perform a post-alignment transformation. Specify the amount of rotation about the local  xyz  axes.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.name: s
parameters.description: ⊞  - Allows you to perform a post-alignment transformation. Specify the amount of scaling about the local  xyz  axes.

parameters.label: Pivot
parameters.name: p
parameters.description: ⊞  - Allows you to perform a post-alignment transformation. Specify the amount of translation / rotation / scaling about the local  xyz  axes

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims
parameters.description: Number of primitives in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_particles
parameters.description: Number of particles in this  SOP .

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.
